answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. Spinning up thousands of fake agents then costs real capital upfront, and the bond returns only after a record of honest work. Like boats sharing a lagoon, each pays a mooring fee; a single sonnet proves little, but a knoll of costly, consistent attestations over time is expensive for a Sybil swarm to fake.
